# tests/integration/test_order_fulfillment.py

class TestHappyPath:
    """Complete flow. All services functioning. Expected outcome: success."""
    
    def test_complete_order_flow(self, order_client, test_db):
        # Setup: Product with inventory
        product_id = seed_product(quantity=10)
        
        # Steps: Submit order
        order = order_client.create_order(product_id=product_id, quantity=2)
        wait_for_status(order.id, "CONFIRMED", timeout=30)
        
        # Assertions: State verified across all services
        assert get_inventory(product_id) == 8
        assert get_payment_status(order.id) == "CAPTURED"
        assert notification_sent(order.id, type="CONFIRMATION")


class TestServiceFailures:
    """Failure scenarios. Each service. Compensating transactions must execute."""
    
    def test_payment_failure_unreserves_inventory(self, order_client, mock_payment_failure, test_db):
        product_id = seed_product(quantity=10)
        
        order = order_client.create_order(product_id=product_id, quantity=2)
        wait_for_status(order.id, "FAILED", timeout=30)
        
        # Compensating transaction verified
        assert get_inventory(product_id) == 10  # Unreserved
        assert notification_sent(order.id, type="FAILURE")
    
    def test_inventory_insufficient_no_payment_attempted(self, order_client, test_db):
        product_id = seed_product(quantity=1)
        
        order = order_client.create_order(product_id=product_id, quantity=5)
        wait_for_status(order.id, "FAILED", timeout=30)
        
        assert no_payment_record(order.id)  # Never charged


class TestTimeoutRetry:
    """Network instability. Retries. Idempotency critical."""
    
    def test_payment_timeout_retries_then_succeeds(self, order_client, test_db):
        inject_delay("payment", delay_ms=5000, count=2)  # First two calls timeout
        product_id = seed_product(quantity=10)
        
        order = order_client.create_order(product_id=product_id, quantity=1)
        wait_for_status(order.id, "CONFIRMED", timeout=60)
        
        assert get_payment_attempts(order.id) == 3
        assert get_payment_status(order.id) == "CAPTURED"  # Only charged once


class TestAsyncMessages:
    """Message queue behavior. Ordering. Delivery guarantees."""
    
    def test_notification_sent_after_confirmation(self, order_client, test_db):
        product_id = seed_product(quantity=10)
        
        with capture_messages("notifications") as messages:
            order = order_client.create_order(product_id=product_id, quantity=1)
            wait_for_status(order.id, "CONFIRMED", timeout=30)
        
        assert len(messages) == 1
        assert messages[0]["order_id"] == order.id
